static_transfer_audit.method: lexical scan for device->host synchronisation idioms in the timestep path. It over-reports by design: a hit inside a debug-only or setup branch is not a live transfer. Every hit is listed so a reviewer can dismiss it explicitly rather than trust an aggregate. jnp.asarray is deliberately NOT a hit -- it is a device constructor, and matching it drowns the real signal.
